BRAND_DESCRIPTION: Second hand in Fuerteventura: send it on WhatsApp and we post it.
HOME_HERO_TEXT: What you no longer use, someone else wants. Send us a photo on WhatsApp and we'll post it for you.
WORKSHOP_INTRO: No accounts, no forms: just WhatsApp. We do the rest.
WORKSHOP_STEP_1_TEXT: Message us on WhatsApp with a photo of what you want to sell and, if you like, the price and a few words.
WORKSHOP_STEP_2_TEXT: We improve the photo with AI, write the listing and check it with you.
WORKSHOP_STEP_3_TEXT: Your listing goes online on Baifo for 3 months. Buyers write to you directly on WhatsApp.
STORE_EMPTY: Listings are coming soon. Want to be the first? Write to us on WhatsApp.
FOOTER_TAGLINE: Second hand in Fuerteventura, on WhatsApp.

## What {shop} is
{shop} is a second-hand noticeboard for private sellers in Fuerteventura. We publish listings from third parties; buyer and seller agree on the sale directly. {shop} does not sell the listed items, does not take payment for them and is not a party to the sale.

## Liability
The content of each listing (description, condition, price) comes from the seller. We check listings before publishing them, but we cannot guarantee they are accurate or answer for the items. If a listing breaks the law or your rights, write to us and we will take it down.

## Intellectual property
The design, logo and texts of {shop} belong to its owner. The photos in listings belong to their sellers.
PRIVACY_TEXT_SHOWCASE:
This policy explains which personal data {shop} processes, why, and which rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Spanish law (LOPDGDD).

## Controller
Jose Miralles, NIE Z1111174A, C. Juan Sebastián Elcano, 12, 35660 Corralejo, Las Palmas, Spain. Email: hola@baifo.es

## If you sell with us
When you write to us on WhatsApp to list something, we process your name, your WhatsApp number, the photos and what you tell us about the item. We use them to prepare and publish your listing (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We improve the photos and write the text with artificial intelligence (OpenAI).
Your WhatsApp number only appears on the website and in the listings list if you consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR); buyers see it when they tap "Contact the seller". You can withdraw your consent at any time.
Each listing is online for at most 3 months. After that, or when you tell us it is sold, we take it down. We delete your data when you ask us to, unless a law requires us to keep it.

## If you visit the website or buy from a seller
To show the website, the server records technical data (IP address, page, time, browser) for security (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) and deletes it after a short time. If you contact a seller on WhatsApp, that conversation is between you and the seller.

## Cookies
We only use technically necessary cookies: one for your language and, for administrators, a session cookie. We do not use analytics, tracking or advertising cookies.

## Who processes data on our behalf
- Vercel Inc. (website hosting)
- Neon Inc. (database)
- UploadThing / Ping Labs Inc. (photo storage)
- OpenAI (AI photo and text improvement)
- Resend Inc. (sending emails)
- ImprovMX (forwarding emails to hola@baifo.es)
- WhatsApp / Meta Platforms Ireland (messaging)
Some of them are in the USA; these transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the EU standard contractual clauses.

## Your rights
You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection and portability of your data by writing to hola@baifo.es. You can also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
